# Class: AudioRenderer

Positional particle audio and lifecycle cues; requires browser audio playback permission and scene camera context.

### update()

```ts
update(
   particles,
   system,
   deltaTime?
): void;
```

[`Particle`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/Particle.html)[]

# Class: BoidAffector

Scene-space flocking target or obstacle, collected by Boids modules and filtered by tags.

# Class: KillZone

Volume that expires matching particles through the normal lifecycle rather than directly splicing the population.

## Extends

- [`SpatialEffect`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/SpatialEffect.html)

# Class: LimitVelocityOverLifetime

Permanently damps velocity toward per-axis limits and optionally applies timestep-scaled drag.

### addSubSystem()


Transfers a child to this parent, resets its local transform, and shares simulation space. Continuous emission defaults on unless an event trigger is selected.

#### Parameters

#### Returns

***

<a id="advanceframes"></a>

### advanceFrames()

```ts
advanceFrames(frames, deltaTime?): void;
```

Advances a root system synchronously using fixed simulation steps.

#### Parameters

##### frames

`number`

Nonnegative integer number of steps.

##### deltaTime?

`number` = `...`

Seconds per step, before simulationSpeed. Defaults to 1 / 60.

#### Returns

`void`

#### Remarks

Reuses prewarm's simulation path, including emission, lifecycle events, modules,
spatial effects, and owned subsystems. Paused, destroyed, and parent-owned
systems do not advance. Does not start playback or perform implicit prewarm.
Camera distance and update LOD do not skip explicit steps. Live cubemap
capture is deferred to normal updates; render the scene after advancing.
Finite systems can naturally end, including their configured end behavior.

***

<a id="clearparticles"></a>

### clearParticles()

```ts
clearParticles(children?): void;
```

`void`

# Abstract Class: Renderer

# Class: ScaleByDepth

Multiplies scale and adds scalar channels using distance from the captured camera, normalized over depthRange; two-value parameter ranges interpolate rather than randomly sample.

# Class: ScaleOverLifetime

Multiplies scale and adds scalar channels in the transient render phase using normalized particle age.

## Extends

- [`Module`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/Module.html)

## Constructors

<a id="constructor"></a>

### Constructor

```ts
new ScaleOverLifetime(options?): ScaleOverLifetime;
```

Creates the modifier with its built-in priority and optional filtering/LOD settings.

# Class: SpeedByDepth

Multiplies scalar integration speed using distance from the captured camera, normalized over depthRange; two-value parameter ranges interpolate rather than randomly sample.

## Extends

- [`Module`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/Module.html)

## Constructors

<a id="constructor"></a>


# Class: SpeedBySize

Multiplies scalar integration speed using particle size normalized over sizeRange; two-value parameter ranges interpolate rather than randomly sample.

## Extends

- [`Module`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/Module.html)

## Constructors

# Class: SpeedOverLifetime

Transiently multiplies the scalar integration speed before movement; does not permanently replace particle velocity.

- [`Module`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/Module.html)

# Class: VelocityByDepth

Adds linear motion channels using distance from the captured camera, normalized over depthRange; two-value parameter ranges interpolate rather than randomly sample.

# Class: VelocityBySize

Adds linear motion channels using particle size normalized over sizeRange; two-value parameter ranges interpolate rather than randomly sample.

# Class: VelocityOverLifetime

Adds age-dependent linear, orbital, and radial motion before integration without accumulating the transient velocity offset.

# API Reference

Browse by responsibility. The main classes come first; configuration and supporting types are grouped below.

## Particle Systems

Start with ParticleSystem, which owns simulation, and Particle, which holds each particle’s state.

- [ParticleSystem](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/ParticleSystem.html)
- [Particle](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/Particle.html)

## Emitters

Choose where particles are born and configure their initial values, timing, and selection.

- [Emitter](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/Emitter.html)
- [EmissionShape](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/EmissionShape.html)

## Modules

Start with the Module base class, then choose modifiers for motion, appearance, or behavior.

- [Module](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/Module.html)

### Motion

- [ForceOverLifetime](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/ForceOverLifetime.html)
- [LimitVelocityOverLifetime](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/LimitVelocityOverLifetime.html)
- [MassByDepth](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/MassByDepth.html)
- [MassBySize](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/MassBySize.html)
- [MassOverLifetime](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/MassOverLifetime.html)
- [NoiseModule](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/NoiseModule.html)
- [OrientToDirection](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/OrientToDirection.html)
- [SpeedByDepth](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/SpeedByDepth.html)
- [SpeedBySize](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/SpeedBySize.html)
- [SpeedOverLifetime](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/SpeedOverLifetime.html)
- [TransformByNoise](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/TransformByNoise.html)
- [VelocityByDepth](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/VelocityByDepth.html)
- [VelocityBySize](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/VelocityBySize.html)
- [VelocityOverLifetime](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/VelocityOverLifetime.html)

### Appearance

- [ColorByDepth](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/ColorByDepth.html)
- [ColorBySize](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/ColorBySize.html)
- [ColorBySpeed](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/ColorBySpeed.html)

```ts
excludeParticleRenderers: boolean;
```

```ts
fps: number;
```

***

```ts
intensity: number;
```

```ts
resolutionScale: number;
```

Capture size relative to renderer dimensions, rounded to a power of two. Defaults to 1 / 16.

### priority

```ts
priority: number;
```

Execution phase: negative is permanent before movement, 0–1 is transient before movement, 1 or greater is transient after movement.


<a id="dampen"></a>

### dampen

```ts
dampen: DynamicValue<number>;
```

Fraction of post-bounce velocity removed at contact, clamped from zero to one.

***

<a id="lifetimeloss"></a>

### lifetimeLoss

```ts
lifetimeLoss: DynamicValue<number>;
```

Fraction of lifetime lost at contact; 1 removes the particle on collision.

***

<a id="maxkillspeed"></a>

### maxKillSpeed

```ts
maxKillSpeed: number;
```

Removes particles above this contact speed; defaults to positive infinity.

***

<a id="minkillspeed"></a>

### minKillSpeed

```ts
minKillSpeed: number;
```

Removes particles below this contact speed; zero disables the lower threshold.

***

### onCollision?


***

<a id="priority"></a>

### priority?

```ts
optional priority?: number;
```

Execution phase: negative is permanent before movement, 0–1 is transient before movement, 1 or greater is transient after movement.

# Interface: EmitterOptions

## Properties

<a id="alignment"></a>

### alignment

```ts
alignment: DynamicValue<number>;
```

Amount of initial rotation alignment to source direction.

#### Default Value

```ts
0
```

***

<a id="bursts"></a>

### bursts

```ts
bursts: Multiple<SpawnBurst>;
```

Timed particle batches within an emission cycle. Supplying bursts changes the default continuous rate to zero.

***

<a id="countlod"></a>

### countLOD

```ts
countLOD: Partial<LODSettings>;
```

Distance-based emitted particle count reduction.

***

<a id="initialvalues"></a>

### initialValues

```ts
initialValues: Partial<InitialParticleValues>;
```

Dynamic values sampled at birth; mutable values are isolated per particle.

***

<a id="radialspeed"></a>

### radialSpeed

```ts
radialSpeed: DynamicValue<number>;
```

Initial velocity contribution along the sampled source direction.

#### Default Value

```ts
1
```

***

<a id="rate"></a>

### rate

```ts
rate: DynamicValue<number>;
```

Continuous particles per second. Defaults to 50 without bursts, otherwise 0.

***

<a id="rateoverdistance"></a>

### rateOverDistance

```ts
rateOverDistance: DynamicValue<number>;
```

Particles per world-space distance traveled by the emission context.

#### Default Value

```ts
0
```

***

<a id="source"></a>

### source

```ts
source: EmissionShape;
```

Geometry and sampling rule used to place particles. Defaults to a sphere.

***

<a id="tags"></a>

### tags

```ts
tags: StrictMultiple<string>;
```

Tags assigned at birth, selected using tagSelection.

***

<a id="tagselection"></a>

### tagSelection

```ts
tagSelection:
  | "all"
  | "random"
  | "distribute"
  | TagSelectionMethod;
```

Assigns all tags, distributes them, or samples them according to the selected mode.

***

<a id="updatelod"></a>

### updateLOD

```ts
updateLOD: Partial<LODSettings>;
```

Distance-based emission update quality.

***

<a id="useupdatelod"></a>

### useUpdateLOD

```ts
useUpdateLOD: boolean;
```

Enables update skipping; defaults to whether updateLOD is provided.

[`ModuleOptions`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/interfaces/ModuleOptions.html).[`priority`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/interfaces/ModuleOptions.html#priority)

[API Reference](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/index.html) / [Supporting Types](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/Supporting-Types/index.html) / ParticleSystemOptions

# Interface: ParticleSystemOptions

Construction options; fields can be omitted to use the documented defaults.

## Properties

<a id="cubemapsettings"></a>

### cubemapSettings

```ts
cubemapSettings: Partial<LiveCubemapOptions>;
```

Dynamic reflection capture options; capture work is separate from simulation.

***

<a id="duration"></a>

### duration

```ts
duration: number;
```

Emission cycle length in seconds, independent of particle lifetime.

#### Default Value

```ts
10
```

***

<a id="emitters"></a>

### emitters

```ts
emitters: Multiple<Emitter>;
```

Sources that create particles. Omission creates one default emitter; pass [] for manual particles.

***

<a id="endbehavior"></a>

### endBehavior

```ts
endBehavior:
  | "none"
  | "destroy"
  | "destroyImmediate"
  | EndBehavior;
```

Controls cleanup after a nonlooping system ends; existing particles may remain.

#### Default Value

```ts
EndBehavior.None
```

***

<a id="gravity"></a>

### gravity

```ts
gravity: Vector3;
```

Gravity acceleration vector; supplying it enables gravity unless gravityModifier overrides that choice.

***

<a id="gravitymodifier"></a>

### gravityModifier

```ts
gravityModifier: DynamicValue<number>;
```

Particle-age-dependent gravity multiplier; defaults to 1 with explicit gravity, otherwise 0.

***

<a id="inheritvelocity"></a>

### inheritVelocity

```ts
inheritVelocity: number;
```

Multiplier for velocity inherited from movement of the emitter context.

***

<a id="livecubemapfps"></a>

### liveCubemapFPS

```ts
liveCubemapFPS: number;
```

Legacy shorthand for cubemapSettings.fps.

***

<a id="livecubemapintensity"></a>

### liveCubemapIntensity

```ts
liveCubemapIntensity: number;
```

Legacy shorthand for cubemapSettings.intensity.

***

<a id="livecubemapresolutionscale"></a>

### liveCubemapResolutionScale

```ts
liveCubemapResolutionScale: number;
```

Legacy shorthand for cubemapSettings.resolutionScale.

***

<a id="looping"></a>

### looping

```ts
looping: boolean;
```

Restarts the emission cycle after duration.

#### Default Value

```ts
true
```

***

<a id="maxcullingmode"></a>

### maxCullingMode

```ts
maxCullingMode: "new" | "old" | MaxCulling;
```

Chooses whether old or newly spawned particles are culled at capacity.

#### Default Value

```ts
MaxCulling.New
```

***

<a id="maxparticles"></a>

### maxParticles

```ts
maxParticles: number;
```

Maximum retained particles; excess particles are culled during simulation.

***

<a id="modules"></a>

### modules

```ts
modules: Multiple<Module>;
```

Ordered composition of particle modifiers; numeric priority determines the execution phase.

***

<a id="prewarm"></a>

### prewarm

```ts
prewarm: boolean;
```

Simulates a cycle before normal playback begins.

#### Default Value

```ts
false
```

***

<a id="prewarmfps"></a>

### prewarmFPS

```ts
prewarmFPS: number;
```

Fixed prewarm steps per second; invalid values fall back to 24.

#### Default Value

```ts
24
```

***

<a id="renderers"></a>

### renderers

```ts
renderers: Multiple<Renderer>;
```

Views of the simulated population. Omission creates a sprite renderer; pass [] for simulation only.

***

<a id="simulationdistance"></a>

### simulationDistance

```ts
simulationDistance: number;
```

Camera-distance limit for normal updates; zero disables distance culling.

#### Default Value

```ts
0
```

***

<a id="simulationspace"></a>

### simulationSpace

```ts
simulationSpace:
  | "local"
  | SimulationSpace
  | "world";
```

Local or world coordinates for simulated particles; changing it converts existing particles.

***

<a id="simulationspeed"></a>

### simulationSpeed

```ts
simulationSpeed: number;
```

Nonnegative multiplier applied to simulation delta seconds.

#### Default Value

```ts
1
```

***

<a id="spatialeffectfilter"></a>

### spatialEffectFilter

```ts
spatialEffectFilter: (spatialEffect) => boolean;
```

Selects which discovered or explicit spatial effects may affect this system.

#### Parameters

##### spatialEffect

[`SpatialEffect`](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/api/classes/SpatialEffect.html)

#### Returns

`boolean`

***

<a id="spatialeffects"></a>

### spatialEffects

```ts
spatialEffects: Multiple<SpatialEffect>;
```

Explicit generic spatial effects, combined with matching scene effects.

***

<a id="updatelod"></a>

### updateLOD

```ts
updateLOD: Partial<LODSettings>;
```

Distance-based simulation update quality; skipped elapsed time is accumulated.

***

<a id="uselivecubemap"></a>

### useLiveCubemap

```ts
useLiveCubemap: boolean;
```

Enables dynamic environment captures; requires renderer/camera context from rendering.

***

<a id="usespatialeffects"></a>

### useSpatialEffects

```ts
useSpatialEffects: boolean;
```

Enables generic spatial-effect processing.

#### Default Value

```ts
true
```

***

<a id="useupdatelod"></a>

### useUpdateLOD

```ts
useUpdateLOD: boolean;
```

Enables distance-based update skipping; defaults to whether updateLOD is supplied.

# Interface: SubSystemOptions

Parent-event emission and inheritance; child systems share their parent simulation clock.

## Properties

<a id="emitcontinuous"></a>

### emitContinuous

```ts
emitContinuous: boolean;
```

Emits while a parent particle remains alive, using an independent emission context.

***

<a id="emitoncollision"></a>

### emitOnCollision

```ts
emitOnCollision: boolean;
```

Starts child emission from collision events reported by a Collision module.

***

<a id="emitondeath"></a>

### emitOnDeath

```ts
emitOnDeath: boolean;
```

Starts child emission when a parent particle expires.

***

<a id="emitonspawn"></a>

### emitOnSpawn

```ts
emitOnSpawn: boolean;
```

Starts child emission when a parent particle is born.

***

<a id="impulseaffectsalignment"></a>

### impulseAffectsAlignment

```ts
impulseAffectsAlignment: boolean;
```

Aligns child emission with collision impulse direction.

***

<a id="impulseaffectslifetime"></a>

### impulseAffectsLifetime

```ts
impulseAffectsLifetime: number;
```

Exponent controlling contact-impulse scaling of child lifetime.

***

<a id="impulseaffectsmass"></a>

### impulseAffectsMass

```ts
impulseAffectsMass: number;
```

Exponent controlling contact-impulse scaling of child mass.

***

<a id="impulseaffectsscale"></a>

### impulseAffectsScale

```ts
impulseAffectsScale: number;
```

Exponent controlling contact-impulse scaling of child size.

***

<a id="impulseaffectsspeed"></a>

### impulseAffectsSpeed

```ts
impulseAffectsSpeed: number;
```

Exponent controlling contact-impulse scaling of child velocity.

***

<a id="impulsethreshold"></a>

### impulseThreshold

```ts
impulseThreshold: number;
```

Minimum contact impulse needed to trigger collision emission.

***

<a id="inheritalpha"></a>

### inheritAlpha

```ts
inheritAlpha: number;
```

Blends child alpha with the triggering particle alpha.

***

<a id="inheritcolor"></a>

### inheritColor

```ts
inheritColor: number;
```

Blends child color with the triggering particle color.

***

<a id="inheritlifetime"></a>

### inheritLifetime

```ts
inheritLifetime: number;
```

Blends child lifetime with the parent lifetime; zero retains independent child timing.

***

<a id="inheritmass"></a>

### inheritMass

```ts
inheritMass: number;
```

Blends child mass with the triggering particle mass.

***

<a id="inheritscale"></a>

### inheritScale

```ts
inheritScale: number;
```

Blends child scale with the triggering particle scale; zero retains child configuration.

***

<a id="inheritvelocity"></a>

### inheritVelocity

```ts
inheritVelocity: number;
```

***

<a id="ratio"></a>

### ratio

```ts
ratio: number;
```

Fraction of eligible parent particles selected for subsystem emission.

***

<a id="shouldemit"></a>

### shouldEmit

```ts
shouldEmit: boolean | ((particle) => boolean);
```

Predicate or switch selecting whether a parent particle may trigger child emission.

<!-- Source: apps/docs/contributing.md -->

# Contributing

Install workspace dependencies with `npm install`, then build packages with `npm run build:modules`. Run `npm test` for the library regression suite and `npm run build --workspace demo` for the interactive application.

## Adding or updating an example

Keep the implementation in `examples/<id>.js` (TypeScript is also supported by the generator). Export its existing async default factory and a literal `metadata` object containing id, title, description, tags, and category. Keep configuration inside the factory; the registry is generated. Preserve factory author information and return a normal ParticleSystem so the demo GUI and serializer continue to work.

Mark actual source using balanced `// #region docs:system`, `docs:emitters`, `docs:modules`, and `docs:renderers` comments, closing each with the matching `// #endregion docs:...`. Named suffixes select individual systems or setup blocks. Nested regions are supported; interleaved closures are errors. Repeated region names concatenate their source blocks. If an optional module list is absent, mark a relevant system declaration and explain its absence.

Run `npm run docs:generate`. It discovers the example, updates the registry and indexes, and creates a missing Markdown guide in `apps/docs/examples`. It preserves every existing guide. Replace the four TODO explanations with the purpose of each component and the observable consequences of important values: rate, lifetime, speed, capacity, curves, material, blending, and renderer costs. Keep the four required sections in order. Update the explanations whenever the configuration changes.

Use `<ExampleCode region="system" />` and the equivalent emitter/module/renderer references. Code is extracted from the canonical source during the site build. Never paste a second implementation into the guide. A named reference such as `modules:rocket` selects only that region; the base name selects all its named regions.

## Documentation and API comments

Write conceptual guides in `apps/docs/guides`. Write concise TSDoc on public source declarations describing defaults, lifecycle, mutation, side effects, units, constraints, and performance. Use `@remarks`, `@defaultValue`, `@example`, and `@see` where useful. Avoid repeating the TypeScript signature in prose. Keep tutorials in Markdown.

Use a properly capitalized H1 as each article's title. Add new guides to the appropriate reading
order in `scripts/docs/navigation.mjs`: Getting Started, Core Concepts, Feature Guides, or
Project & Deployment. The sidebar and guide overview read titles directly from the articles;
generation rejects guides missing from this structure. The API overview and sidebar are generated
from actual TypeDoc pages and public export sources by `scripts/docs/api-structure.mjs`. Keep
core classes first and place new API classes in a suitable feature group. Supporting signature
types belong under Types, while Modules contains actual particle modifiers.

`npm run docs:generate` regenerates TypeDoc Markdown, registry/index data, linked agent reference pages, and `llms.txt`/`llms-full.txt`. Those files are generated and must not be edited manually. Example guides, conceptual guides, and `.agents/skills/rzmps/SKILL.md` are authored. Commit regenerated artifacts alongside source changes. TypeDoc validates comment syntax and links; generation fails on warnings.

Run `npm run docs:check` to validate source regions, metadata, complete explanations, local links, generated artifact consistency, and the VitePress build. Check mode compares outputs without rewriting them. Use `npm run docs:dev` to read the site locally. Static output is `apps/docs/.vitepress/dist`; `npm run site:build` combines it with the demo in root `dist`, with documentation under `/docs/`. The [deployment guide](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/guides/deployment.html) explains the Render build settings and rewrites for `/docs` and `/docs/`.

## Visual inspection

```bash
npm run preview -- --example fireworks --backend webgl --frames 6 --interval 20 --warmup 60 --delta-time 0.0166667 --width 800 --height 600 --output ./previews/fireworks
npm run preview -- --example fire --backend webgpu --output ./previews/fire-webgpu
npm run preview -- --example collision --scene 'Collision (builtin/Octree)' --backend webgl
```

The preview builds and serves the production demo from an isolated temporary directory with Puppeteer, reusing the benchmark infrastructure and Vite configuration. Concurrent preview processes keep separate build assets. Build packages first. If Puppeteer's browser is missing, install it with `npx puppeteer browsers install chrome`. It captures PNGs directly from the rendering canvas, labels a contact sheet with fixed simulation times, and writes diagnostics to metadata.json even on runtime failure. Backend unavailability is a failure and never triggers a silent fallback.

Inspect the contact sheet after changing effect configuration. Try longer warmup for delayed emission and shorter intervals for flashes. For elevated fireworks, use `--camera-position 8,15,32 --camera-target 0,12,0`; camera settings and `--camera-fov` are recorded in metadata. A neutral scene is the default; select a demo scene to validate geometry-dependent effects. Preview output is ignored by git. `npm run preview:smoke` exercises representative sprite and mesh examples on both backends without pixel-perfect snapshots; it is an optional CI workflow because renderer availability and costs vary.

## Review

Include the example checklist in pull requests adding or substantially changing presets. Describe relevant test and preview results. Report benchmark impact for performance changes. Package publishing and documentation deployment have separate workflows. See the [deployment guide](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/guides/deployment.html) for Render configuration.


## Author credits and generated posters

Keep author attribution in the existing factory's literal `.author` assignment (a GitHub
username or an object with `name` and optional `url`). `<ExampleAttribution />` resolves that
source at build time; changing the author updates the site and generated agent Markdown.
Use `<ExamplePreview />` for the generated poster without copying its URL into authored prose.

After adding or changing an example, run `npm run docs:generate`. It automatically builds the
local packages and captures missing or stale example images; unchanged images are reused.
Install Chrome once with `npx puppeteer browsers install chrome` if needed.
Review and commit each generated PNG and the source-hash manifest in `apps/docs/public/previews`.
Capture defaults and scene/camera overrides live in `scripts/docs/preview-settings.json`.
`docs:check` rejects missing, modified, or stale images without requiring a browser in CI.

The canonical agent installation guide is [AI Coding Assistants](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/guides/ai-coding-assistants.html).
It supplies generated README guidance blocks. The full skill stays in `.agents/skills/rzmps`;
only the short template-derived `AGENTS.md` is included in npm. Run `npm run agents:check`
to validate format, reference links, temporary skill installs, and package contents.


---

<!-- Source: apps/docs/examples/additiveSmoke.md -->


# Additive Smoke

Additive blending with soft particles and layered lifetime color ramps for luminous smoke.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Additive%20Smoke)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Additive Smoke](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/additiveSmoke.png)

## Particle System Configuration

A 10-second loop and 4.5-second particle lifetime maintain a slow plume. Gravity modifier -0.015 adds gentle upward acceleration. The simulation matches the ordinary smoke structure, making the blending change easy to compare using the same camera and warmup.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/additiveSmoke.js#L18)

```js
  const smoke = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 10,
    looping: true,
    gravityModifier: -0.015,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.75, 1.2, 24),
        }),
        rate: 36,
        radialSpeed: 0.18,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 4.5,
          speed: 0.55,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(2.5, 2.5, 2.5),
          color: [new THREE.Color('#343230'), new THREE.Color('#79746e')],
          alpha: 0.35,
          velocity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.75, 0),
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.35, 0.65),
        frequency: 0.8,
      }),
      new LimitVelocityOverLifetime({
        limit: new THREE.Vector3(1.1, 1.35, 1.1),
        drag: 0.1,
        multiplyDragByVelocity: true,
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const size = (0.35 + (1.8 - 0.35) * time);
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        color: new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),
        alpha: (time) => ((time) < 0.2 ? (time) / 0.2 : (time) < 0.75 ? 1 - 0.15 * (((time) - 0.2) / 0.55) : 0.85 * (1 - (((time) - 0.75) / 0.25))),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0)],
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Default, {
        material: 'lit',
        alphaMap: smokeAlpha,
        softParticleDistance: 1,
        materialOptions: {
          roughness: 1,
          normalLighting: 0.5,
          sphericalNormals: 1,
          blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
        }
      }),
    ],
  });
```


## Emitters

The cone source emits 36 particles per second, giving roughly 162 live particles before culling. Scale 2.5 creates overlapping patches, but initial alpha 0.35 and the darker color range reduce the brightness contributed by each patch. Upward velocity 0.75 and radial speed 0.18 hold the plume together near the base.


[Source: emitters:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/additiveSmoke.js#L23)

```js
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.75, 1.2, 24),
        }),
        rate: 36,
        radialSpeed: 0.18,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 4.5,
          speed: 0.55,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(2.5, 2.5, 2.5),
          color: [new THREE.Color('#343230'), new THREE.Color('#79746e')],
          alpha: 0.35,
          velocity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.75, 0),
        },
      }),
    ],
```


## Modules

Low-frequency noise (0.8) moves the smoke in broad curls, with less vertical than horizontal strength. Velocity limits and drag contain the flow. Growing scale from 0.35 to 1.8 widens older particles, while the fade envelope and varied angular velocities prevent visible rectangular births and repeated texture alignment.


[Source: modules:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/additiveSmoke.js#L42)

```js
    modules: [
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.35, 0.65),
        frequency: 0.8,
      }),
      new LimitVelocityOverLifetime({
        limit: new THREE.Vector3(1.1, 1.35, 1.1),
        drag: 0.1,
        multiplyDragByVelocity: true,
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const size = (0.35 + (1.8 - 0.35) * time);
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        color: new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),
        alpha: (time) => ((time) < 0.2 ? (time) / 0.2 : (time) < 0.75 ? 1 - 0.15 * (((time) - 0.2) / 0.55) : 0.85 * (1 - (((time) - 0.75) / 0.25))),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0)],
      }),
    ],
```


## Renderers

The lit smoke sprites use AdditiveBlending, so overlapping particles brighten the scene rather than darkening it like opaque soot. The low starting alpha counterbalances that accumulation. Roughness 1 and spherical normals retain lighting cues, while soft-particle distance 1 blends contacts with scene geometry.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/additiveSmoke.js#L68)

```js
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Default, {
        material: 'lit',
        alphaMap: smokeAlpha,
        softParticleDistance: 1,
        materialOptions: {
          roughness: 1,
          normalLighting: 0.5,
          sphericalNormals: 1,
          blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
        }
      }),
    ],
```

<!-- Source: apps/docs/examples/boids.md -->


# Boids

Flocking particles using ParticleOctree aggregation, with red hazard particles acting as tagged particle affectors.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Boids)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Boids](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/boids.png)

## Particle System Configuration

The 24-second loop and lifetimes up to 22 seconds sustain two interacting populations. Gravity is disabled so steering controls their paths. maxParticles 700 bounds the flocking workload; the estimated full-lifetime population can approach that cap as both populations build up.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/boids.js#L67)

```js
  const system = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 24,
    looping: true,
    gravity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
    gravityModifier: 0,
    maxParticles: 700,

    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: flockSource,
        rate: 38,
        radialSpeed: 0.9,
        tags: 'boid',
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [9, 16],
          speed: [3.2, 4.8],
          color: flockColors,
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.34, 0.34, 0.34),
            new THREE.Vector3(0.48, 0.48, 0.48),
          ],
          alpha: 0.88,
        },
      }),
      new Emitter({
        source: hazardSource,
        rate: 2,
        radialSpeed: 0.72,
        tags: 'hazard',
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [14, 22],
          speed: [2.6, 3.7],
          color: hazardColors,
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.65, 0.65),
            new THREE.Vector3(1.05, 1.05, 1.05),
          ],
          alpha: 0.95,
        },
      }),
    ],

    modules: [
      boids,
      hazardBoids,
      new OrientToDirection({
        axis: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
      }),
    ],

    renderers: [
      new MeshRenderer({
        tags: 'boid',
        mesh: new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.32, 0.9, 12, 1),
          new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            roughness: 0.52,
            metalness: 0.05,
            emissive: new THREE.Color('#071018'),
            emissiveIntensity: 0.18,
          }),
        ),
      }),
      new MeshRenderer({
        tags: 'hazard',
        mesh: new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.38, 1.05, 14, 1),
          new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            roughness: 0.35,
            metalness: 0.05,
            emissive: new THREE.Color('#601018'),
            emissiveIntensity: 0.55,
          }),
        ),
      }),
    ],
  });
```


## Emitters

The main flock emits 38 particles per second from a radius-12 sphere, while two hazards per second begin on a torus. Tags separate their rules. Main lifetimes 9–16 and hazard lifetimes 14–22 make the hazards persist longer; hazards are also larger (0.65–1.05 versus 0.34–0.48), making pursuit and avoidance visible.


[Source: emitters:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/boids.js#L75)

```js
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: flockSource,
        rate: 38,
        radialSpeed: 0.9,
        tags: 'boid',
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [9, 16],
          speed: [3.2, 4.8],
          color: flockColors,
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.34, 0.34, 0.34),
            new THREE.Vector3(0.48, 0.48, 0.48),
          ],
          alpha: 0.88,
        },
      }),
      new Emitter({
        source: hazardSource,
        rate: 2,
        radialSpeed: 0.72,
        tags: 'hazard',
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [14, 22],
          speed: [2.6, 3.7],
          color: hazardColors,
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.65, 0.65),
            new THREE.Vector3(1.05, 1.05, 1.05),
          ],
          alpha: 0.95,
        },
      }),
    ],
```


## Modules

Two Boids modules use opposite particle-affector roles: hazards repel boids as obstacles, while boids act as targets for hazards. Main separation weight 2.4 exceeds cohesion 1.35 to resist clumping. Hazard affector weight 5.5 makes target seeking strong. OrientToDirection aligns cone geometry with motion so heading remains readable.


[Source: modules:setup](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/boids.js#L27)

```js
  const boids = new Boids({
    tags: 'boid',
    alignmentWeight: 1.55,
    cohesionWeight: 1.35,
    separationWeight: 2.4,
    affectorWeight: 2.2,
    affectorDistance: 1.8,
    steering: 3.75,
    particleAffectors: [
      {
        sourceTags: 'hazard',
        tags: 'boid',
        weight: Boids.BoidAffector.Weight.Obstacle,
        distance: 1.8,
      },
    ],
  });
```


[Source: modules:setup](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/boids.js#L47)

```js
  const hazardBoids = new Boids({
    tags: 'hazard',
    alignmentWeight: 1.25,
    cohesionWeight: 1,
    separationWeight: 2.15,
    affectorWeight: 5.5,
    affectorDistance: 3.2,
    steering: 3.35,
    particleAffectors: [
      {
        sourceTags: 'boid',
        tags: 'hazard',
        weight: Boids.BoidAffector.Weight.Target,
        distance: 2.6,
      },
    ],
  });
```


[Source: modules:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/boids.js#L112)

```js
    modules: [
      boids,
      hazardBoids,
      new OrientToDirection({
        axis: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
      }),
    ],
```


## Renderers

Two tag-filtered MeshRenderers use cone meshes and separate materials. Cool flock colors contrast with red/orange hazards, whose material has stronger emissive intensity 0.55. The geometric cone points reveal direction more clearly than a circular billboard would.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/boids.js#L122)

```js
    renderers: [
      new MeshRenderer({
        tags: 'boid',
        mesh: new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.32, 0.9, 12, 1),
          new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            roughness: 0.52,
            metalness: 0.05,
            emissive: new THREE.Color('#071018'),
            emissiveIntensity: 0.18,
          }),
        ),
      }),
      new MeshRenderer({
        tags: 'hazard',
        mesh: new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.38, 1.05, 14, 1),
          new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            roughness: 0.35,
            metalness: 0.05,
            emissive: new THREE.Color('#601018'),
            emissiveIntensity: 0.55,
          }),
        ),
      }),
    ],
```

# Bubbles

Refractive sprite transmission with spherical normals and size-driven distortion. Both continuous sounds and collision-triggered bubble pops.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Bubbles)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Bubbles](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/bubbles.png)

## Particle System Configuration

The 10-second loop uses a small gravity modifier 0.05 and live cubemap reflections. Particle lifetimes 7–12 seconds allow slow movement and collisions. The physics remains ordinary particles; transmission and distortion create the bubble appearance.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/bubbles.js#L53)

```js
  const system = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 10,
    looping: true,
    gravityModifier: 0.05,
    useLiveCubemap: true,

    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5, 16, 12),
        }),

        rate: 8,

        radialSpeed: [1, 3],

        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [7, 12],

          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
            new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1),
          ],

          mass: 0.25,

          color: [
            new THREE.Color('#bdefff'),
            new THREE.Color('#d8c8ff'),
            new THREE.Color('#bfffe4'),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],

    modules: [
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.2, 0.05, 0.2),
        frequency: 0.6,
      }),

      new Collision({
        bounce: 0.9,
        dampen: 0.03,
        radiusScale: 1,
        lifetimeLoss: 1,
      }),

      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1).multiplyScalar(Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time * 5, 0, 1))),
      }),

      new DistortionBySize({
        sizeRange: [0, 1],
        distortionStrength: [0, 1]
      }),
    ],

    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Circle, {
        material: 'lit',

        materialOptions: {
          roughness: 0.15,
          metalness: 0.5,
          sphericalNormals: 1,
          normalLighting: 0.75,
          transmissionMap: simple,
          transmission: 0.7,
          distortionMap: distortionSimple,
          distortionStrength: -0.05,
        },
      }),
      new AudioRenderer({
        sound: bubbles,

        onCollisionSound: [
          bubblePop1,
          bubblePop2,
        ],

        // Only a few particles need looping positional audio.
        // Having every bubble play the same bubbling track would get loud.
        ratio: 0.15,

        // Every bubble pops
        collisionRatio: 1,

        pitch: 1,
        volume: 1,

        // Larger bubbles have a somewhat deeper sound.
        sizeAffectsPitch: 0.3,
        sizeAffectsVolume: 0.15,

        // Fade the looping sound with the particle.
        alphaAffectsPitch: 0,
        alphaAffectsVolume: 1,

        // Fast-moving bubbles become slightly more animated sounding.
        speedAffectsPitch: 0.08,
        speedAffectsVolume: 0.05,
      }),
    ],
  });
```


## Emitters

Eight particles per second from a radius-0.5 sphere yield around 76 particles at average lifetime before contact losses. Scale 0.25–1 gives varied bubble sizes, and radial speed 1–3 spreads them. Mass 0.25 changes the physics response relative to the heavier collision examples.


[Source: emitters:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/bubbles.js#L60)

```js
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5, 16, 12),
        }),

        rate: 8,

        radialSpeed: [1, 3],

        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [7, 12],

          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
            new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1),
          ],

          mass: 0.25,

          color: [
            new THREE.Color('#bdefff'),
            new THREE.Color('#d8c8ff'),
            new THREE.Color('#bfffe4'),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],
```


## Modules

Gentle noise strength (0.2, 0.05, 0.2) adds lateral wobble. Collision lifetimeLoss 1 removes bubbles on contact, driving their pop cue. Scale grows rapidly during the first fifth of life rather than appearing at full size immediately. DistortionBySize maps size 0–1 to distortion multiplier 0–1, emphasizing larger bubbles.


[Source: modules:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/bubbles.js#L91)

```js
    modules: [
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.2, 0.05, 0.2),
        frequency: 0.6,
      }),

      new Collision({
        bounce: 0.9,
        dampen: 0.03,
        radiusScale: 1,
        lifetimeLoss: 1,
      }),

      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1).multiplyScalar(Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time * 5, 0, 1))),
      }),

      new DistortionBySize({
        sizeRange: [0, 1],
        distortionStrength: [0, 1]
      }),
    ],
```


## Renderers

The lit sprite combines spherical normals, low roughness 0.15, transmission 0.7, and distortion strength -0.05 to suggest a curved transparent shell. Only ratio 0.15 of particles play the looping bubble track, while collisionRatio 1 permits every bubble to pop. Size lowers pitch and slightly increases volume; inspect sound in the interactive demo as well as the visual preview.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/bubbles.js#L116)

```js
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Circle, {
        material: 'lit',

        materialOptions: {
          roughness: 0.15,
          metalness: 0.5,
          sphericalNormals: 1,
          normalLighting: 0.75,
          transmissionMap: simple,
          transmission: 0.7,
          distortionMap: distortionSimple,
          distortionStrength: -0.05,
        },
      }),
      new AudioRenderer({
        sound: bubbles,

        onCollisionSound: [
          bubblePop1,
          bubblePop2,
        ],

        // Only a few particles need looping positional audio.
        // Having every bubble play the same bubbling track would get loud.
        ratio: 0.15,

        // Every bubble pops
        collisionRatio: 1,

        pitch: 1,
        volume: 1,

        // Larger bubbles have a somewhat deeper sound.
        sizeAffectsPitch: 0.3,
        sizeAffectsVolume: 0.15,

        // Fade the looping sound with the particle.
        alphaAffectsPitch: 0,
        alphaAffectsVolume: 1,

        // Fast-moving bubbles become slightly more animated sounding.
        speedAffectsPitch: 0.08,
        speedAffectsVolume: 0.05,
      }),
    ],
```

<!-- Source: apps/docs/examples/collision.md -->


# Collision

Particle collision with automatic mesh detection and sorting between static and dynamic objects for optimizing octree rebuilds. Alternatively Jolt, Rapier, and Ammo can be used as external physics backends, allowing particles to affect other physics objects in the scene.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Collision)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Collision](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/collision.png)

## Particle System Configuration

A five-second loop emits particles with eight-second lifetimes under full gravity modifier 1. Long life lets several bounces remain visible. Select a collision scene in the demo or pass a collision scene to the preview command; a neutral empty scene cannot show contacts.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collision.js#L13)

```js
  const collision = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 5,
    looping: true,
    gravityModifier: 1,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.25, 16, 12),
        }),
        rate: 30,
        radialSpeed: [1, 5],
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 8,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(0.125, 0.125, 0.125),
          mass: 1,
          color: [
            new THREE.Color('#ff6633'),
            new THREE.Color('#ffd166'),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new Collision({
        bounce: 0.75,
        dampen: 0.05,
        radiusScale: 1,
        applyImpulses: true,
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Circle, {
        material: 'lit',
        castShadow: true,

        materialOptions: {
          roughness: 0.5,
          sphericalNormals: 1,
          normalLighting: 1,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```


## Emitters

The radius-0.25 sphere emits 30 particles per second with radial speeds 1–5. At lifetime eight, the population can approach 240 before culling. Mass 1 and uniform scale 0.125 make contact behavior easier to compare, while the orange/yellow range distinguishes particles from collision geometry.


[Source: emitters:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collision.js#L18)

```js
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.25, 16, 12),
        }),
        rate: 30,
        radialSpeed: [1, 5],
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 8,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(0.125, 0.125, 0.125),
          mass: 1,
          color: [
            new THREE.Color('#ff6633'),
            new THREE.Color('#ffd166'),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],
```


## Modules

Collision uses bounce 0.75 and dampen 0.05, retaining substantial rebound while losing some motion at each contact. radiusScale 1 uses the particle’s normal collision size. applyImpulses true allows compatible external backends to transfer contact impulses to scene bodies; the built-in mesh backend supplies geometric collision queries.


[Source: modules:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collision.js#L38)

```js
    modules: [
      new Collision({
        bounce: 0.75,
        dampen: 0.05,
        radiusScale: 1,
        applyImpulses: true,
      }),
    ],
```


## Renderers

Lit Circle sprites use spherical normals and normal lighting 1 to appear round at low geometric cost. Roughness 0.5 softens highlights and castShadow true helps locate particles above scene geometry. Shadows require the scene lights and renderer to enable shadow support.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collision.js#L48)

```js
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Circle, {
        material: 'lit',
        castShadow: true,

        materialOptions: {
          roughness: 0.5,
          sphericalNormals: 1,
          normalLighting: 1,
        },
      }),
    ],
```

# Metal Balls

Collision-triggered subsystems and sound effects with physics-driven EQ filtering and live-cubemap rendering for convincing metallic surfaces.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Metal%20Balls)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Metal Balls](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/collisionSubEmitters.png)

## Particle System Configuration

The parent loops every five seconds under gravity and uses live cubemap reflections with intensity 3. A separate nonlooping spark system lasts 0.08 seconds as an emission window. It is triggered on contacts above impulse threshold 1.2; inheritance and impulse scaling let spark motion differ from the heavy parent.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collisionSubEmitters.js#L30)

```js
  const collision = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 5,
    looping: true,
    gravityModifier: 1,
    useLiveCubemap: true,
    liveCubemapIntensity: 3,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: EmissionShape.Sphere(0.25),
        rate: 5,
        radialSpeed: [1, 5],
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 8,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(0.125, 0.125, 0.125),
          mass: 1,
          color: new THREE.Color('#aaa'),
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new Collision({
        bounce: 0.75,
        dampen: 0.05,
        radiusScale: 1,
        applyImpulses: true,
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Circle, {
        material: 'lit',
        castShadow: true,
        materialOptions: {
          roughness: 0.2,
          metalness: 0.6,
          sphericalNormals: 1,
          normalLighting: 1,
        },
      }),
      new AudioRenderer({
        onCollisionSound: ballHit,
        collisionRatio: 1,
        pitch: [0.8, 1.2],
        volume: 0.18,
        impulseAffectsVolume: 0.5,
        impulseThreshold: 0.5,
        lowPass: 1800,
        impulseAffectsLowPass: 1,
      }),
    ],
  });
```


[Source: system:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collisionSubEmitters.js#L89)

```js
  const sparks = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 0.08,
    looping: false,
    gravityModifier: 1,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.01, 0.01, 32, 1, true),
          source: EmissionSource.Volume,
        }),
        rate: 0,
        bursts: [{ time: 0, count: [3, 6] }],
        radialSpeed: [0.5, 2],
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [0.18, 0.42],
          scale: [new THREE.Vector3(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), new THREE.Vector3(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)],
          color: [
            new THREE.Color('#fff4b0'),
            new THREE.Color('#ff8a3d'),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        alpha: (time) => Math.max(0, 1 - time),
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new TrailRenderer({
        texture: Textures.Circle,
        lifetime: 0.16,
        minimumVertexDistance: 0.015,
        dieWithParticles: false,
        width: 0.18,
        sizeAffectsWidth: true,
        inheritParticleColor: true,
        materialOptions: {
          emissive: new THREE.Color('#ffb347'),
          emissiveIntensity: 2,
          roughness: 1,
          transparent: true,
          depthWrite: false,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```


## Emitters

The balls emit at five per second with lifetime eight, keeping the population near 40 for manageable collision and audio costs. Each contact burst emits 3–6 sparks with lifetimes 0.18–0.42 and radial speed 0.5–2. The short emission window does not truncate those particle lifetimes.


[Source: emitters:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collisionSubEmitters.js#L37)

```js
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: EmissionShape.Sphere(0.25),
        rate: 5,
        radialSpeed: [1, 5],
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 8,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(0.125, 0.125, 0.125),
          mass: 1,
          color: new THREE.Color('#aaa'),
        },
      }),
    ],
```


[Source: emitters:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collisionSubEmitters.js#L94)

```js
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.01, 0.01, 32, 1, true),
          source: EmissionSource.Volume,
        }),
        rate: 0,
        bursts: [{ time: 0, count: [3, 6] }],
        radialSpeed: [0.5, 2],
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [0.18, 0.42],
          scale: [new THREE.Vector3(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), new THREE.Vector3(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)],
          color: [
            new THREE.Color('#fff4b0'),
            new THREE.Color('#ff8a3d'),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],
```


## Modules

The parent Collision module retains bounce 0.75 and dampen 0.05, so balls can strike surfaces repeatedly. The spark ColorOverLifetime module fades linearly. Subsystem impulse factors increase spark scale and speed for stronger contacts and align emission using the collision normal.


[Source: modules:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collisionSubEmitters.js#L52)

```js
    modules: [
      new Collision({
        bounce: 0.75,
        dampen: 0.05,
        radiusScale: 1,
        applyImpulses: true,
      }),
    ],
```


[Source: modules:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collisionSubEmitters.js#L115)

```js
    modules: [
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        alpha: (time) => Math.max(0, 1 - time),
      }),
    ],
```


## Renderers

Lit sprites with metalness 0.6 and roughness 0.2 make live reflections visible. Collision audio uses volume 0.18, pitch variation 0.8–1.2, and impulse-dependent volume and low-pass filtering. Sparks use short 0.16-second emissive trails with depth writing disabled so their bright streaks layer cleanly. PNG previews cannot validate the sound itself.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collisionSubEmitters.js#L62)

```js
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Circle, {
        material: 'lit',
        castShadow: true,
        materialOptions: {
          roughness: 0.2,
          metalness: 0.6,
          sphericalNormals: 1,
          normalLighting: 1,
        },
      }),
      new AudioRenderer({
        onCollisionSound: ballHit,
        collisionRatio: 1,
        pitch: [0.8, 1.2],
        volume: 0.18,
        impulseAffectsVolume: 0.5,
        impulseThreshold: 0.5,
        lowPass: 1800,
        impulseAffectsLowPass: 1,
      }),
    ],
```


[Source: renderers:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/collisionSubEmitters.js#L122)

```js
    renderers: [
      new TrailRenderer({
        texture: Textures.Circle,
        lifetime: 0.16,
        minimumVertexDistance: 0.015,
        dieWithParticles: false,
        width: 0.18,
        sizeAffectsWidth: true,
        inheritParticleColor: true,
        materialOptions: {
          emissive: new THREE.Color('#ffb347'),
          emissiveIntensity: 2,
          roughness: 1,
          transparent: true,
          depthWrite: false,
        },
      }),
    ],
```

<!-- Source: apps/docs/examples/cubes.md -->


# Cube Instances

Instanced mesh rendering with randomized cube particles and simple lifetime rotation and fade-out.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Cube%20Instances)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Cube Instances](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/cubes.png)

## Particle System Configuration

A 10-second loop keeps emission continuous, while zero gravity isolates instanced mesh appearance and rotation. Lifetimes of 4–8 seconds leave enough time to watch each cube tumble before it fades away.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/cubes.js#L21)

```js
  const system = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 10,
    looping: true,
    gravity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
    gravityModifier: 0,

    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        rate: 12,
        radialSpeed: 1,

        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [4, 8],
          speed: 1,
          color: colors,
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.4, 0.4, 0.4),
            new THREE.Vector3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0),
          ],
          alpha: 1,
        },
      }),
    ],

    modules: [
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(5, 0, 1), new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, -5)],
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        alpha: (t) => (1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(t, 0, 1)))
      })
    ],

    renderers: [
      new MeshRenderer({
        mesh: new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
          new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial()
        ),
        castShadow: true,
        receiveShadow: true,
      }),
    ],
  });
```


## Emitters

Rate 12 and mean lifetime 6 imply roughly 72 simultaneous cubes. The discrete color Set avoids intermediate hues. Scale ranges from 0.4 to 1, applied to a 0.25-unit box mesh, so visible cube edges stay small enough to separate the instances.


[Source: emitters:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/cubes.js#L28)

```js
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        rate: 12,
        radialSpeed: 1,

        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [4, 8],
          speed: 1,
          color: colors,
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.4, 0.4, 0.4),
            new THREE.Vector3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0),
          ],
          alpha: 1,
        },
      }),
    ],
```


## Modules

Angular velocity is sampled between differently oriented vectors so cubes do not all rotate around the same axis. The cubic fade keeps them opaque early and removes them near death. There is no added acceleration module, so the emitter’s initial motion stays easy to distinguish from rotation.


[Source: modules:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/cubes.js#L48)

```js
    modules: [
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(5, 0, 1), new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, -5)],
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        alpha: (t) => (1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(t, 0, 1)))
      })
    ],
```


## Renderers

MeshRenderer instances a BoxGeometry and MeshStandardMaterial. Cast and receive shadows are enabled, making real geometric faces apparent when the scene has shadow-casting lights. Compare this example with the sprite-based Spheres preset to see the difference between geometry and spherical normal shading.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/cubes.js#L59)

```js
    renderers: [
      new MeshRenderer({
        mesh: new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
          new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial()
        ),
        castShadow: true,
        receiveShadow: true,
      }),
    ],
```

<!-- Source: apps/docs/examples/dopplerBullet.md -->


# Doppler Bullet

Doppler effect on a fast bullet particle, with smoke, faint trails, spawn blast effects, and distortion wake subsystems.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Doppler%20Bullet)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Doppler Bullet](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/dopplerBullet.png)

## Particle System Configuration

The root loops over 5.5 seconds, caps at eight particles, and disables gravity for nearly straight flight. Four subsystems provide smoke wake, heat wake, muzzle flash, and spawn shockwave. Their inheritance factors are zeroed so the small fast bullet does not force every secondary effect to copy its scale or velocity.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/dopplerBullet.js#L39)

```js
  const bulletSystem = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 5.5,
    looping: true,
    maxParticles: 8,
    useLiveCubemap: true,
    cubemapSettings: {
      fps: 8,
      resolutionScale: 0.5,
      intensity: 1.35,
    },
    gravity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: bulletEmissionCone(),
        rate: 0.9,
        radialSpeed: [0.1, 0.35],
        alignment: 1,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 1.9,
          velocity: [
            new THREE.Vector3(-0.38, -0.16, -31),
            new THREE.Vector3(0.38, 0.16, -36),
          ],
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(0.22, 0.22, 0.22),
          color: new THREE.Color('#d7c091'),
          alpha: 1,
          mass: 1,
        },
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new MeshRenderer({
        mesh: bulletMesh,
        maxParticles: 8,
        castShadow: true,
        receiveShadow: true,
      }),
      new TrailRenderer({
        mode: TrailMode.Particle,
        ratio: 1,
        lifetime: 0.28,
        minimumVertexDistance: 0.1,
        dieWithParticles: false,
        width: 0.055,
        widthOverTrail: (time) => 1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1)),
        colorOverTrail: (time) => new THREE.Color().lerpColors(
          new THREE.Color('#f9e6ae'),
          new THREE.Color('#8391a5'),
          THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1),
        ),
        inheritParticleColor: true,
        textureMode: TrailTextureMode.Stretch,
        materialOptions: {
          map: simpleSpriteTexture,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.22,
          depthWrite: false,
          roughness: 0.9,
        },
      }),
      new AudioRenderer({
        sound: bulletLoopSound,
        onSpawnSound: gunshotSound,
        loop: true,
        maxClips: 8,
        volume: 3.5,
        pitch: [0.82, 1.24],
        lowPass: 14000,
        speedAffectsVolume: 0.12,
        depthAffectsVolume: 0.45,
        dopplerEffect: 2.4,
      }),
    ],
  });
```


[Source: system:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/dopplerBullet.js#L169)

```js
  return new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 1.1,
    looping: true,
    gravity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.2, 0),
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: EmissionShape.Sphere(0.08, 8, 6),
        rate: 0,
        rateOverDistance: 5,
        radialSpeed: 0.1,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [0.55, 0.95],
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.18, 0.18, 0.18),
            new THREE.Vector3(0.34, 0.34, 0.34),
          ],
          velocity: [
            new THREE.Vector3(-0.18, 0.02, -0.25),
            new THREE.Vector3(0.18, 0.35, 0.25),
          ],
          color: [new THREE.Color('#9a9fa4'), new THREE.Color('#d8d0c0')],
          alpha: 0.1,
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new ForceOverLifetime({
        force: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.12, 0),
      }),
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.2, 0.65),
        frequency: 1.6,
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1);
          const size = 0.85 + 2.35 * Easing.cubic.out(t);
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        color: new THREE.Color('#d0c8bc'),
        alpha: (time) => fadeInOut(time, 0.18, 0.65),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0)],
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Default, {
        material: 'lit',
        alphaMap: smokeAlpha,
        softParticleDistance: 1.2,
        materialOptions: {
          opacity: 0.62,
          roughness: 0.8,
          depthWrite: false,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```


[Source: system:3](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/dopplerBullet.js#L241)

```js
  return new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 0.7,
    looping: true,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: EmissionShape.Sphere(0.04, 8, 6),
        rate: 24,
        radialSpeed: 0.18,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [0.5, 0.85],
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(0.9, 0.9, 0.9),
            new THREE.Vector3(1.45, 1.45, 1.45),
          ],
          velocity: [
            new THREE.Vector3(-0.04, 0.02, 0.25),
            new THREE.Vector3(0.04, 0.16, 0.65),
          ],
          color: new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1);
          const size = 0.45 + 1.75 * Easing.cubic.out(t);
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new DistortionOverLifetime({
        distortionStrength: (time) => fadeInOut(time, 0.15, 0.55),
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        alpha: (time) => 0.95 * fadeInOut(time, 0.12, 0.58),
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Default, {
        billboard: false,
        alphaMap,
        materialOptions: {
          opacity: 0.62,
          transmission: 1,
          distortionMap,
          distortionStrength: 0.1,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          depthWrite: false,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```


[Source: system:4](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/dopplerBullet.js#L304)

```js
  return new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 0.45,
    looping: true,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: pointEmissionShape(),
        bursts: [{ time: 0, count: 5 }],
        rate: 0,
        radialSpeed: [0.2, 0.8],
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: [0.22, 0.36],
          scale: [
            new THREE.Vector3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0),
            new THREE.Vector3(1.8, 1.8, 1.8),
          ],
          velocity: [
            new THREE.Vector3(-0.35, -0.12, -0.2),
            new THREE.Vector3(0.35, 0.32, 0.8),
          ],
          color: [new THREE.Color('#ffffff'), new THREE.Color('#ffd07a')],
          alpha: 1,
          rotation: [
            new THREE.Vector3(-Math.PI, 0, 0),
            new THREE.Vector3(Math.PI, 0, 0),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1);
          const size = (0.32 + 1.45 * Easing.cubic.out(t)) * (1 - 0.35 * Easing.cubic.in(t));
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        color: (time) => new THREE.Color().lerpColors(
          new THREE.Color('#fff8d7'),
          new THREE.Color('#ff9f45'),
          THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1),
        ),
        alpha: (time) => 1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1)),
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(texture, {
        gridSize: { x: 5, y: 4 },
        frames: 20,
        fps: 36,
        softParticleDistance: 1,
        materialOptions: {
          opacity: 0.82,
          depthWrite: false,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```

## Emitters

The bullet emits at rate 0.9 with lifetime 1.9 seconds and z velocity from -31 to -36. Its source cone is placed near z=34, giving it a long path across the scene. Smoke uses rateOverDistance 5, maintaining wake spacing as the bullet moves; flash and shockwave use time-zero bursts rather than continuous emission.


[Source: emitters:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/dopplerBullet.js#L51)

```js

            new THREE.Vector3(-0.38, -0.16, -31),

          scale: new THREE.Vector3(0.22, 0.22, 0.22),

          alpha: 1,
          mass: 1,
        },
      }),
    ],
```

## Modules

The root has no explicit module list. Secondary smoke uses force, noise, growth, rotation, and a fade envelope. Heat and shockwave systems grow while distortion fades; flash color shifts from pale yellow to orange. These separate timing curves keep the initial flash brief while the slower wake remains visible.


[Source: modules:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/dopplerBullet.js#L197)

```js
    modules: [
      new ForceOverLifetime({
        force: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.12, 0),
      }),
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.2, 0.65),
        frequency: 1.6,
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1);
          const size = 0.85 + 2.35 * Easing.cubic.out(t);
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        color: new THREE.Color('#d0c8bc'),
        alpha: (time) => fadeInOut(time, 0.18, 0.65),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0)],
```

## Renderers

The metallic mesh is paired with a faint 0.28-second trail of width 0.055 and opacity 0.22. AudioRenderer uses dopplerEffect 2.4, speed/depth volume response, and pitch variation to emphasize a fast flyby. The 5×4 flash atlas plays at 36 fps, while non-billboard, double-sided distortion sprites show the shockwave from either side.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/dopplerBullet.js#L72)

```js
    renderers: [
      new MeshRenderer({
        mesh: bulletMesh,
        maxParticles: 8,
        castShadow: true,
        receiveShadow: true,
      }),
      new TrailRenderer({
        mode: TrailMode.Particle,
        ratio: 1,
        lifetime: 0.28,
        minimumVertexDistance: 0.1,
        dieWithParticles: false,
        width: 0.055,
        widthOverTrail: (time) => 1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1)),
        colorOverTrail: (time) => new THREE.Color().lerpColors(
          new THREE.Color('#f9e6ae'),
          new THREE.Color('#8391a5'),
          THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1),
        ),
        inheritParticleColor: true,
        textureMode: TrailTextureMode.Stretch,
        materialOptions: {
          map: simpleSpriteTexture,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.22,
          depthWrite: false,
          roughness: 0.9,
        },
      }),
      new AudioRenderer({
        sound: bulletLoopSound,
        onSpawnSound: gunshotSound,
        loop: true,
        maxClips: 8,
        volume: 3.5,
        pitch: [0.82, 1.24],
        lowPass: 14000,
        speedAffectsVolume: 0.12,
        depthAffectsVolume: 0.45,
        dopplerEffect: 2.4,
      }),
    ],
```


[Source: renderers:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/dopplerBullet.js#L222)

# Fire

Sprite-sheet animation, soft particles, particle lights, and a heat-distortion subsystem.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Fire)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Fire](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/fire.png)

## Particle System Configuration

The 10-second loop schedules a continuous flame; individual flame particles last only 1.35 seconds. The shorter particle lifetime keeps the flame near its source while the secondary distortion system supplies a separate one-second heat shimmer. Inheritance is disabled for the shimmer’s appearance so its scale and opacity do not collapse with the flame.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L28)

```js
  const fire = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 10,
    looping: true,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1.7, 24),
          source: EmissionSource.Surface,
        }),
        rate: 90,
        radialSpeed: 0.2,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 1.35,
          speed: 1.2,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(2.5, 2.5, 2.5),
          color: [new THREE.Color('#ff9c88'), new THREE.Color('#ffd47f')],
          alpha: 0.95,
          velocity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.2, 0),
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new VelocityOverLifetime({
        linear: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.25, 0),
      }),
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(2.1, 2.1, 2.1),
        frequency: 1.35,
      }),
      new ForceOverLifetime({
        force: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, 0),
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const size = (1.3 + (0.2 - 1.3) * time);
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        color: new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),
        alpha: (time) => ((time) < 0.2 ? (time) / 0.2 : (time) < 0.75 ? 1 - 0.15 * (((time) - 0.2) / 0.55) : 0.85 * (1 - (((time) - 0.75) / 0.25))),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(-0.5, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0.5, 0, 0)],
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(fireSprite, {
        gridSize: { x: 8, y: 4 },
        frames: 32,
        fps: 24,
        softParticleDistance: 1,
      }),
      new LightRenderer({
        count: 18,
        ratio: 0.3,
        randomDistribution: true,
        inheritParticleColor: true,
        sizeAffectsRange: true,
        alphaAffectsIntensity: true,
        brightness: 1.8,
        rangeMultiplier: 3,
        lightOptions: {
          color: new THREE.Color('#ffb570'),
          intensity: 1,
          distance: 8,
          decay: 2,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```


[Source: system:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L132)

```js
  return new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 1,
    looping: true,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: EmissionShape.Sphere(0.05, 8, 6),
        rate: options.rate,
        radialSpeed: 1,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: options.lifetime,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(options.scale, options.scale, options.scale),
          velocity: new THREE.Vector3(0, options.velocity, 0),
          color: new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),
          rotation: [
            new THREE.Vector3(-Math.PI, 0, 0),
            new THREE.Vector3(Math.PI, 0, 0),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new VelocityOverLifetime({
        linear: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, 0),
      }),
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.35, 0.65),
        frequency: 1.7,
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const size = (0.35 + (1.8 - 0.35) * time) * (1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1)));
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        alpha: (time) => Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time * 5, 0, 1)) * (1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp((time - 0.8) * 5, 0, 1))),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [
          new THREE.Vector3(-0.45, 0, 0),
          new THREE.Vector3(0.45, 0, 0),
        ],
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Default, {
        alphaMap,
        softParticleDistance: 2.5,
        materialOptions: {
          transmission: 1,
          distortionMap,
          distortionStrength: 0.05,
          depthWrite: false,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```


## Emitters

A cone surface spreads the base of the flame. At 90 particles per second and a 1.35-second lifetime, the main population is roughly 122 sprites before culling. Upward velocity 2.2 and radial speed 0.2 make vertical flow dominate the horizontal spread; the 2.5-unit scale lets adjacent sprites overlap.


[Source: emitters:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L32)

```js
    emitters: [

          source: EmissionSource.Surface,
        }),

        radialSpeed: 0.2,

          lifetime: 1.35,
          speed: 1.2,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(2.5, 2.5, 2.5),
          color: [new THREE.Color('#ff9c88'), new THREE.Color('#ffd47f')],
          alpha: 0.95,
          velocity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.2, 0),
        },
      }),
    ],
```


[Source: emitters:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L136)



## Modules

Noise strength 2.1 and frequency 1.35 break up the regular rise. The additional upward force bends the motion over time, while the scale multiplier shrinks from 1.3 to 0.2. The alpha curve fades in during the first fifth of life and fades out over the final quarter, hiding sprite births and deaths. The distortion subsystem uses gentler noise and its own grow-and-fade curve.


[Source: modules:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L52)

```js
    modules: [
      new VelocityOverLifetime({
        linear: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.25, 0),
      }),
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(2.1, 2.1, 2.1),
        frequency: 1.35,
      }),
      new ForceOverLifetime({
        force: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, 0),
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const size = (1.3 + (0.2 - 1.3) * time);
          return new THREE.Vector3(size, size, size);
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        color: new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),
        alpha: (time) => ((time) < 0.2 ? (time) / 0.2 : (time) < 0.75 ? 1 - 0.15 * (((time) - 0.2) / 0.55) : 0.85 * (1 - (((time) - 0.75) / 0.25))),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(-0.5, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0.5, 0, 0)],
      }),
    ],
```


[Source: modules:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L155)

```js
    modules: [
      new VelocityOverLifetime({
        linear: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, 0),
      }),
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.35, 0.65),
        frequency: 1.7,
      }),
```

## Renderers

The 8×4 atlas contains 32 flame frames played at 24 fps, approximately one animation across the 1.35-second life. Soft-particle distance 1 blends intersections. Particle lights are limited to 18 with ratio 0.3, avoiding a light per sprite. The secondary sprite transmits the background with distortion strength 0.05 and disables depth writing so the shimmer does not occlude the flame.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L79)

```js
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(fireSprite, {
```
